# Four bounded chart types in 0.3

[简体中文](../zh-CN/chart-expansion-03.md)

## Contract and supported scope

Radar, node-link tree, Sankey and regional map extend experimental **0.3 intent**. All eleven branches now compile; 0.1/0.2 and native-mode capabilities remain unchanged. Read `get_chart_schema({schemaVersion:"0.3",chartType:"radar"})` for an exact branch and `list_capabilities` for limits. Full native ECharts configuration, treemaps, automatic data collection and online maps are outside this profile.

| Type | Source and rules | Identity and presentation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| radar | One ordinary-table row per item; 1–6 unique nonempty item names, 3–8 distinct numeric indicators, explicit finite min < max and optional units. Null, missing, duplicate items and out-of-range values fail. | Source rows or optional row keys; independent indicator ranges are stated in the summary. No normalization or inferred ranges. Multiple items require a legend. |
| tree | Ordinary table with id/parentId/label field references. One root with null parent; 1–1000 unique IDs, existing parents, acyclic/reachable, root depth 0 and maximum depth 16. Labels may repeat. | Stable node IDs. Optional initialDepth 0–2 (default 2). Compatible topology/encoding preserves collapsed state across reorder/update/resize; topology changes reset it. No value is inferred from child count. |
| sankey | Graph data has independent inline/reference nodes and links tables, resolved atomically within a combined 1 MiB budget. ≤200 nodes/1000 edges, unique node IDs, valid endpoints, no directed cycles/self-links/duplicate directed pairs, finite nonnegative weights. | Node ID and ordered-endpoint edge ID; duplicate display labels remain distinct. Zero edges and nodes without positive flow are not drawn but stay in full tables. Incoming/outgoing/difference are reported; no conservation or percentage assumption. |
| map | Ordinary table, exact region/value fields, mapRef id/revision and explicit finite colorDomain min < max. Duplicate/unknown regions and non-null out-of-range values fail. ≤1000 rows. | Stable region IDs; absent source row has rowIndex null. Zero is a measured value, null and absent use a missing-data color. Raw and rendered tables distinguish provided/absent. |

New branches reject legend overrides: radar requires its item legend, while tree/Sankey/map use labels or a continuous scale. Tree/Sankey also reject dataLabels overrides because node labels are required; radar/map permit dataLabels.show.

All inputs are JSON. Fields/values are not silently renamed, normalized, sorted or summed. Scalar source tables and all original graph links remain accessible and appear in SVG metadata. Radar indicator units are descriptive and never convert source values.

## Rendering, state and exports

Two host themes, transparent background and five detail levels use the shared chat presentation planner. Required radar legends, tree/Sankey labels and map scales remain available; dense layouts may use explicit browser table fallback or return SVG EXPORT_LIMIT. Diagrams below 320px use fallback rather than squeeze labels. Full raw text remains in tables if visual labels are truncated. Map labels use the declared theme surface behind text when enabled, rather than assuming all region fills provide text contrast.

The shared ECharts bridge installs fixed Sankey label/tooltip callbacks that return source text literally, including ECharts template markers. RenderPlan remains JSON; no model callbacks or code are accepted or executed. Stable internal IDs are separate from display labels.

Tree SVG is an explicitly labelled **initial collapsed overview**, with full source hierarchy in title/metadata. It does not export the browser's current expansion state or claim that every descendant is visible. Browser expansion changes neither data nor revision; changed topology resets expansion. Chart selection events use eventVersion 0.3 with identity node/edge/region and source row mapping; radar retains row/key selection. Empty or zero-flow Sankey inputs draw no invented flow. Zoom retention is unsupported.

## Trusted map assets

`@chartnexus/echarts` is a shared local workspace package with the existing ECharts 6.1.0 peer. `createMapAsset(input)` clones and validates a host asset, normalizes FeatureCollection geometry, and computes a synchronous SHA-256 shared by Node and browsers. Required host fields: id, revision, coordinateSystem:"WGS84", license, provenance, geoJSON. Each feature has a unique properties.name matching the document's region key. Only Polygon/MultiPolygon with finite 2D coordinates, longitude ±180/latitude ±90, closed nondegenerate rings are accepted. No CRS conversion, SVG maps, geometry collections or antimeridian-crossing segments. This is bounded shape validation, not comprehensive GIS topology certification (for example, it does not prove rings never self-intersect). Hosts remain responsible for geometry correctness and redistribution rights.

Limits are ≤5 MiB host asset JSON, 20000 total coordinate points and 1000 features per asset. Shared ECharts registrations are capped at eight revisions and 20 MiB normalized geometry per module instance. Names include id/revision/hash. Reusing identical assets does not consume capacity; changing geometry under an existing id/revision is rejected. Since ECharts cannot unregister maps, disposal does not free this capacity; use a fresh rendering process/worker when exhausted. The registration checks detect external overwrites within the reserved namespace. Do not directly register maps under `chartnexus:` names.

```ts
import { createMapAsset, mapCatalog } from '@chartnexus/echarts';
import { mountChart } from '@chartnexus/runtime';
import { compileChart } from '@chartnexus/core';
// assetInput is trusted host-owned JSON, never a model tool argument.
const prepared = createMapAsset(assetInput);
if (!prepared.ok) throw new Error('Invalid host map');
const maps = { [prepared.value.id]: prepared.value };
const plan = compileChart(chartDocument, dataRegistry, mapCatalog(maps));
const mounted = mountChart(container, onSelect, { maps, chatPresentation: {} });
if (mounted.ok) mounted.value.update(chartDocument, dataRegistry);
```

Pass the same `maps` host option to renderSvg, createAgentService, or an OpenUI/A2UI/COSUI/Marklang adapter. Core receives only metadata/region keys through MapCatalog. The renderer revalidates geometry/hash; the Node worker receives the host snapshot and performs the same checks under its existing deadline/memory/output budgets. Agent list_capabilities exposes registered map metadata/keys, never coordinates. Default CLI/MCP processes have no maps; a map recipe requires a configured host. No model argument can register a map, select a file/URL or bypass the host registry.

The [authored rectangles](../../examples/maps/two-regions.json) are Apache-2.0 synthetic test data, not administrative boundaries. The public [map recipe](../../resources/recipes/map-03.json) refers to two-regions@1, and its manifest declares the host requirement. No real boundary assets are bundled or downloaded.

## Preview, resources and evidence

Run `pnpm dev` and open `/expansion.html` to switch chart/theme/detail/width, edit complete JSON, inspect full data and click marks. Existing upstream demos accept `?m3=radar|tree|sankey|map` for the same authored fixtures. [Radar](../../resources/recipes/radar-03.json), [tree](../../resources/recipes/tree-03.json), [Sankey](../../resources/recipes/sankey-03.json) and map recipes, negative mutations, capability limits, diagnostics and MCP/RAG copies are generated from canonical resources.

See [SPEC-0035](../../specs/0035-chart-expansion/spec.md) and [acceptance evidence](../../specs/0035-chart-expansion/tasks.md). Local compiler/browser/SVG/worker and pinned upstream SDK checks are distinct from real-model success. M4 held-out evaluation, all-package clean installs, performance baselines, remote CI and publication remain open. No universal protocol/model or broad accessibility certification is claimed.

# ChartDocument 0.3 and core boundaries

0.3 is experimental and intent-only. Its canonical schema has eleven type-specific branches. All eleven compiler types are implemented: bar, line, pie, scatter, combo, funnel, heatmap, radar, tree, Sankey and map. Map rendering requires a trusted host asset. See the [four new chart contracts](chart-expansion-03.md). A schema-valid document is not a renderer-support claim.

## Contract and discovery

`chartDocument03Schema` and `projectChartSchema03(type)` come from `@chartnexus/schema`; projections are exact branches from the same union. Ordinary charts/radar/tree use inline or referenced tables. Sankey uses `{kind:"graph",nodes:<table>,links:<table>}`. Maps use a table plus trusted `chart.mapRef:{id,revision}` and explicit color domain. Heatmap requires its heatmap configuration structurally. Unknown fields are rejected, with property paths in diagnostics. Numeric ranges, references, keys and supported combinations still need compilation.

MCP: `get_chart_schema({schemaVersion:"0.3",chartType:"bar"})`. CLI: `pnpm cli schema --schema-version 0.3 --chart-type bar`. The default schema tool remains 0.1. Full schema and implemented capabilities have `/0.3` resources; all eleven types appear in `charts` with type-specific and host-asset constraints. `getChartInputContract({schemaVersion:"0.3",chatPresentation:true})` returns a complete matching example; its default recommendation remains 0.2 for existing hosts.

## Explicit migration and identity

`migrateIntentTo03(document, registry?)` validates and compiles the old intent before checking the converted 0.3 structure. It changes only the version and converts `{theme:{id,version:"1"}}` to `{theme:"light"|"dark"}`. Unsupported or type-irrelevant old fields are rejected, never silently discarded. Native documents stay on 0.1; migration is never automatic.

Optional `data.keyField` names a declared field containing unique nonempty strings up to 256 characters. Source order and numeric values do not change. `RenderPlan.rowKeys` follows the same sorting/selection mapping as rowIndices. 0.3 events declare `eventVersion:"0.3"`; keyed selections have `identity:"key"`, rowKey and current rowIndex. Without keys they remain positional; aggregated selections retain aggregate metadata rather than fabricated row keys. Nonfatal notices are structured code/severity/path/message with optional params. M3 adds node/edge/region identities for tree, Sankey and map; see the expansion guide.

## Internal responsibilities and evaluation foundation

Core now separates version validation, data-table resolution, legacy compilation, explicit transforms, temporal parsing, combo/funnel/heatmap handlers and presentation. The dispatcher exposes versions without importing DOM/network/model SDKs. Existing chart reuse inside the legacy 0.2 implementation is preserved for numeric equivalence; the four M3 types use independent compilers.

M0 source/option/row-index golden fixtures and existing aggregation, temporal, unit and failure tests guard extraction. `scripts/evaluation-harness.mjs` separates model-visible prompts from expected source hashes/rendered values, records initial versus at-most-two-repair outcomes and requires model/settings/compiler provenance. Its synthetic tests are harness tests, not held-out model results. Actual private suites must stay out of resources/retrieval; final A16 remains M4 work.

See [M1 spec](../../specs/0033-contracts-core/spec.md) and [tasks](../../specs/0033-contracts-core/tasks.md).

# Chat host quality and support matrix

## Presentation and access

Chat is host opt-in for 0.2/0.3 intent. `resolvePresentation(plan,{width,height,target,theme})` is pure; browser runtime supplies current content dimensions and SVG supplies requested dimensions. Without dimensions, compileChatChart retains its declared default styling rather than claiming responsive layout. The bounded layout reserves title, legend, axes and heatmap scale space. Dense labels can be suppressed with a notice even when explicitly requested; full raw values remain accessible. Widths below 240px, narrow dual axes and insufficient plot space use an explicit browser table fallback. SVG returns `EXPORT_LIMIT` when mandatory content cannot fit; increase dimensions rather than silently dropping it.

The shared light/dark token set is checked on declared white/#111827 surfaces. Transparent backgrounds require a matching host surface; arbitrary backgrounds are not certified. Normal text targets 4.5:1 and essential palette/axis colors 3:1. Animations remain disabled. Native HTML buttons/details provide keyboard access; tables paginate source rows in groups of 50 without dropping them, preserve null and units, and rendered marks include aggregation/source mapping. SVG includes a title and escaped JSON metadata containing full source and rendered tables. Hosts can read this metadata; SVG itself is static.

Browser controls are owned siblings of the chart container and are removed on disposal. Host CSS must allow them to remain visible and reachable. Legend selection is retained by semantic keys when chart type/encoding/units are compatible. Removed keys disappear, new keys are visible, incompatible changes emit `STATE_RESET`. Reserved JavaScript legend keys receive invisible rendering aliases while accessible labels and source values stay original. Zoom retention is not a supported profile.

## Lifecycle and transactions

`mountChart` still fails immediately for zero size. `observeChartMount` lets adapters wait, initialize one runtime when measurable and cancel observation on disposal. They retain the latest complete valid pending input; partial/invalid input never becomes a committed revision. Marklang also waits for a measurable container and stages all charts offscreen at the content width. Only a successful complete staging replaces the old nodes. Failure disposes staging alone. Limits are 16 charts, 1 MiB Markdown and a combined 1 MiB parsed input/registry budget, with temporary old/new coexistence bounded by two accepted documents.

Resize uses a snapshot of the last compiled plan and does not advance data/chart revision. Callback exceptions are reported separately; failed rendering attempts restoration. A `RENDER_RECOVERY_FAILED` diagnostic requires remounting. Marklang replaces whole documents, so interaction retention and per-chart revisions do not span those replacements.

## Streaming

`createChartStreamBuffer` now lives in runtime and retains the A2UI compatibility export. It buffers decoded JSON; it does not prove transport completion. `readOllamaStream` incrementally decodes strict UTF-8 NDJSON, enforces a 4 MiB wire budget and 1 MiB document budget, and requires `done:true` with `done_reason:"stop"`. Truncated, missing-terminal, malformed, aborted or extra-after-terminal responses never return a completed operation.

The local Ollama page uses the same-origin proxy with `stream:true`, a 120-second request deadline, cancellation, generation epochs and starting chart revisions. Manual edits invalidate stale generated results. It permits two bounded repairs and records attempts separately. One real synthetic qwen3.5:9b run passed first try, preserved values [3,5], and cancellation passed; see [evidence](../../specs/0034-chat-host-quality/ollama-verification.json). This is a smoke test, not a provider comparison or factual-data retrieval service. SSE is not an Ollama transport supported by this decoder; other transports must supply their own framing before using the neutral buffer.

## Pinned local host matrix

| Host | Representation/completion | Chat/theme/table | Zero size | Ordered operations | Legend retention |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OpenUI react-lang 1.0.2 / React 19.2.4 | JSON string; upstream streaming=false | yes | waits | host opt-in | compatible updates |
| A2UI React 0.9.1 / web_core 0.9.2 | resolved DynamicString; host completed operation | yes | waits | host opt-in | compatible updates |
| COSUI Dynamic UI 1.0.0 / San 3.15.5 | document object; host complete input | yes | waits | host opt-in | compatible updates |
| Marklang 1.0.1 | named data/directive; explicit complete=true | yes | waits for transaction | explicitly rejected | resets on whole-document swap |

Selection, validation errors, valid recovery and disposal use the shared runtime and pinned real SDK fixtures. Marklang parses trusted/sanitized Markdown only; this work does not sanitize arbitrary HTML. No upstream-standard guarantee is inferred from ChartNexus envelopes. Remote hosts, hydration, other SDK versions, mobile certification and broad accessibility certification remain unverified. See [M2 spec](../../specs/0034-chat-host-quality/spec.md).

## M3 chart expansion

0.3 now supports radar, tree, Sankey and trusted regional maps in addition to the original seven types. See [contracts, host MapRegistry, resources and preview](chart-expansion-03.md). Browser/SVG/worker and four pinned upstream SDK paths have local evidence; M4 model evaluation and distribution remain separate. Fixed renderer-owned label callbacks preserve text literally; model callbacks remain forbidden.

# 0.3 的四类有界图表

[English](../en/chart-expansion-03.md)

## 契约与支持范围

雷达、节点连线树、桑基和区域地图扩展实验性 **0.3 intent**。十一种分支现均可编译，0.1/0.2 和原生模式的能力范围不变。通过 `get_chart_schema({schemaVersion:"0.3",chartType:"radar"})` 获取精确分支，`list_capabilities` 获取限制。完整 ECharts 配置、矩形树图、自动采集数据和在线地图不在本 profile 内。

| 类型 | 数据及规则 | 身份与展示 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| radar | 普通表每行一个对象；1–6 个唯一非空名称、3–8 个不同数值指标、显式有限 min < max 和可选单位。拒绝 null、缺失、重名和越界。 | 原始行或可选行键；摘要说明各指标独立范围，不归一化、不猜范围。多对象需要图例。 |
| tree | 普通表 id/parentId/label 字段引用；唯一根的 parent 为 null，1–1000 个唯一 ID、合法父节点、无环且可达，根深度0、最大16。label 可重复。 | 稳定节点 ID。initialDepth 可选0–2，默认2；拓扑/编码相同时重排、更新、resize 保留折叠状态，拓扑变化重置。不把子节点数当数值。 |
| sankey | graph 含独立 inline/reference 的 nodes/links 表，原子解析且合计≤1MiB。≤200 节点/1000 边，唯一节点 ID、合法端点、无有向环/自环/重复有向边、有限非负权。 | 节点 ID 和有序端点对边 ID；重复显示标签保持独立。零边及无正流量节点不绘制，但完整表保留。报告流入/流出/差额，不推断守恒或百分比。 |
| map | 普通表、明确 region/value 字段、mapRef id/revision、显式有限 colorDomain min < max。拒绝重复/未知区域及非 null 越界值，≤1000 行。 | 稳定区域 ID；没有来源行时 rowIndex 为 null。0 是实测值，null 和缺失用缺失色，原始/渲染表区分 provided/absent。 |

所有输入为 JSON，不静默重命名、归一化、排序或求和。完整源表和原始图边可访问，并写入 SVG 元信息。雷达指标单位仅描述数据，不转换原始值。

## 渲染、状态与导出

两主题、透明背景和五档展示复用聊天展示规划器。必要雷达图例、树/桑基标签和地图色阶保留；密集布局可显式回退为浏览器数据表，或返回 SVG EXPORT_LIMIT。图形宽度小于320px时回退，不强行挤压标签。视觉截断时表格仍保留完整原文。地图标签启用时使用声明主题的背景色衬底，不假设所有区域填色都能提供文字对比度。

共享 ECharts 桥安装固定的桑基标签/提示回调，按原文返回源标签，包含 ECharts 模板符号。RenderPlan 仍是 JSON，不接受或执行模型提供的回调/代码。稳定内部 ID 与显示标签分离。

树图 SVG 明确标为**初始折叠概览**，标题/元信息包含完整源层级。它不导出浏览器当前展开状态，也不声称每个后代都可见。浏览器展开不改变数据或 revision，拓扑变化重置展开。选择事件带 eventVersion 0.3，identity 为 node/edge/region 并关联原始行；雷达保持行/行键选择。空桑基或全零流量不会绘制虚构流。不支持缩放状态保留。

## 可信地图资产

`@chartnexus/echarts` 是共享本地 workspace 包，复用既有 ECharts 6.1.0 peer。`createMapAsset(input)` 克隆校验宿主资产、规范化 FeatureCollection，并在 Node/浏览器同步计算相同 SHA-256。宿主字段为 id、revision、coordinateSystem:"WGS84"、license、provenance、geoJSON。每个 feature 的唯一 properties.name 对应文档区域键。仅接受 Polygon/MultiPolygon、有限二维坐标、经度±180/纬度±90、闭合且非退化的环。不做 CRS 转换，不支持 SVG 地图、GeometryCollection 或跨反经线线段。这是有界结构验证，不是完整 GIS 拓扑认证，例如不证明环绝无自交；宿主负责几何正确性及分发权利。

每个宿主资产 JSON ≤5MiB、合计20000坐标点、1000个 feature。共享 ECharts 注册上限为每模块实例8个版本、20MiB规范化几何。注册名包含 id/revision/hash；重复使用相同资产不增容量，同 id/revision 改几何会拒绝。ECharts 没有注销接口，dispose 不释放此容量；耗尽后需新的渲染进程/worker。保留命名空间内的外部覆盖可被检测，不要直接用 `chartnexus:` 名称注册地图。

```ts
import { createMapAsset, mapCatalog } from '@chartnexus/echarts';
import { mountChart } from '@chartnexus/runtime';
import { compileChart } from '@chartnexus/core';
// assetInput 是可信宿主 JSON，不是模型工具参数。
const prepared = createMapAsset(assetInput);
if (!prepared.ok) throw new Error('Invalid host map');
const maps = { [prepared.value.id]: prepared.value };
const plan = compileChart(chartDocument, dataRegistry, mapCatalog(maps));
const mounted = mountChart(container, onSelect, { maps, chatPresentation: {} });
if (mounted.ok) mounted.value.update(chartDocument, dataRegistry);
```

renderSvg、createAgentService、OpenUI/A2UI/COSUI/Marklang 适配器也接收同一 `maps` 宿主选项。core 通过 MapCatalog 只接收元信息/区域键；渲染器重新校验几何/hash，Node worker 接收宿主快照并在已有时限/内存/输出预算下执行相同检查。Agent 的 list_capabilities 只暴露注册元信息/键，不包含坐标。默认 CLI/MCP 进程没有地图；地图 recipe 需要配置宿主。模型参数不能注册资产、选择文件/URL 或绕过 registry。

[项目自制矩形](../../examples/maps/two-regions.json)是 Apache-2.0 合成测试数据，不代表行政边界。[地图 recipe](../../resources/recipes/map-03.json)引用 two-regions@1，manifest 明示宿主要求。本项目未打包或下载真实行政边界。

## 预览、模型资源与证据

运行 `pnpm dev` 后打开 `/expansion.html`，可切换图表/主题/档位/宽度、编辑完整 JSON、查看完整数据和点击图元。已有上游宿主演示也接受 `?m3=radar|tree|sankey|map` 加载同一组自制样例。[雷达](../../resources/recipes/radar-03.json)、[树](../../resources/recipes/tree-03.json)、[桑基](../../resources/recipes/sankey-03.json)和地图 recipe、负例变更、能力限制、诊断和 MCP/RAG 副本由规范资源生成。

见 [SPEC-0035](../../specs/0035-chart-expansion/spec.zh-CN.md)及[验收证据](../../specs/0035-chart-expansion/tasks.zh-CN.md)。本地编译/浏览器/SVG/worker/固定上游 SDK 验证不等于真实模型成功率。M4 隐藏集评测、全包干净安装、性能基线、远端 CI 和发布仍待完成，不声称所有协议/模型兼容或全面无障碍认证。

# ChartDocument 0.3 与核心模块边界

0.3 为实验性、仅 intent 的版本，规范 Schema 包含十一种类型专属分支。十一种类型现均可编译：柱状、折线、饼图、散点、组合、漏斗、热力、雷达、树、桑基和地图；地图渲染需要可信宿主资产。见[四类新图契约](chart-expansion-03.md)。结构合法不代表渲染器已经支持。

## 契约与发现

`@chartnexus/schema` 导出 `chartDocument03Schema` 与 `projectChartSchema03(type)`，投影直接来自同一联合的精确分支。普通图表、雷达、树使用 inline/reference 表；桑基使用 `{kind:"graph",nodes:<table>,links:<table>}`；地图使用普通表与可信 `chart.mapRef:{id,revision}` 及显式色域。热力配置缺失会在结构层拒绝；未知字段不被删除，诊断带字段路径。数值范围、引用、键及受支持组合仍由编译验证。

MCP：`get_chart_schema({schemaVersion:"0.3",chartType:"bar"})`；CLI：`pnpm cli schema --schema-version 0.3 --chart-type bar`。Schema 工具默认仍为 0.1。完整 Schema 和已实现能力提供 `/0.3` 资源，十一种类型均进入 `charts`，同时声明各类限制和宿主资产要求。`getChartInputContract({schemaVersion:"0.3",chatPresentation:true})` 返回匹配的完整示例；为兼容已有宿主，默认推荐版本仍是 0.2。

## 显式迁移与身份

`migrateIntentTo03(document, registry?)` 先校验并编译旧 intent，再检查转换后的 0.3 结构。只修改版本，并将 `{theme:{id,version:"1"}}` 转为 `{theme:"light"|"dark"}`。不支持或与图表类型无关的旧字段会被拒绝，不静默丢弃。原生文档保留 0.1，迁移不会自动发生。

可选 `data.keyField` 指向已声明字段，值必须是最长 256 字符的唯一非空字符串。原始顺序和数值不变；`RenderPlan.rowKeys` 随 rowIndices 使用同一排序和选择映射。0.3 事件声明 `eventVersion:"0.3"`，键身份选择包含 `identity:"key"`、rowKey 和当前 rowIndex。未声明键时仍为位置身份；聚合点保留聚合元数据，不伪造行键。非致命提示包含 code/severity/path/message，可选 params。M3 为树、桑基和地图新增 node/edge/region 身份，详见扩充指南。

## 核心职责与评测基础

core 已拆分版本校验、数据表解析、旧版编译、显式变换、时间解析、组合/漏斗/热力处理及展示。分发入口不依赖 DOM、网络或模型 SDK。为确保数值等价，保留旧 0.2 内部已有的图表复用；四种 M3 类型使用独立编译器。

M0 源数据/option/行索引 golden 夹具及已有聚合、时间、单位、失败测试保护拆分。`scripts/evaluation-harness.mjs` 将模型可见提示词与预期数据哈希/渲染值分离，记录首次及最多两次修复结果，并要求模型、设置和编译器来源。合成测试仅验证框架，不是独立模型成绩。实际私有评测集不得进入 resources/retrieval；最终 A16 仍属于 M4。

# 聊天宿主质量与支持矩阵

## 展示与访问

聊天展示由宿主显式启用，接受 0.2/0.3 intent。`resolvePresentation(plan,{width,height,target,theme})` 为纯函数；浏览器传当前内容尺寸，SVG 传请求尺寸。不传尺寸时 compileChatChart 保留默认样式，不声称响应式布局。布局为标题、图例、坐标轴和热力色阶预留空间；即使显式请求标签，过密时也可能带提示隐藏，但完整原始值仍可访问。宽度小于 240px、过窄的双轴或绘图区不足时，浏览器明确回退到数据表入口。SVG 装不下必要内容时返回 `EXPORT_LIMIT`，需增大尺寸，不静默删除内容。

共享明暗主题在声明的白色/#111827 背景上检查对比度。透明背景需要宿主背景匹配，不声称适配任意背景。正文目标 4.5:1，必要色板和轴线 3:1。仍禁用动画。原生 HTML button/details 提供键盘访问；源数据表每页 50 行，可翻页访问全部数据，保留 null、单位；渲染值也包含聚合和来源映射。SVG 内含 title 及转义后的完整源数据/渲染表 JSON metadata，宿主可读取；SVG 本身是静态内容。

浏览器控件作为图表容器的同级节点由 runtime 管理，销毁时移除；宿主 CSS 应保证可见、可访问。图表类型/编码/单位兼容时按语义键保留图例选择；删除键清理、新键默认显示，不兼容变化产生 `STATE_RESET`。JavaScript 保留名称使用不可见的渲染别名，访问标签和原始值不变。本阶段不支持缩放状态保留。

## 生命周期与事务

`mountChart` 保留零尺寸立即失败契约。`observeChartMount` 供适配器等待可测量尺寸，只初始化一个 runtime，销毁时取消观察。等待期间保留最后完整合法输入，不将部分或非法输入提交为修订。Marklang 同样等待可测量容器，以内容区宽度在屏幕外暂存全部图表，全部成功后才替换旧节点；失败仅释放暂存。限制为 16 图、1 MiB Markdown、解析输入与 registry 合计 1 MiB；旧新暂时共存限两个已接受文档。

resize 使用上次编译成功的快照，不推进数据或图表修订。回调异常独立报告；渲染失败尝试恢复，`RENDER_RECOVERY_FAILED` 要求重新挂载。Marklang 整体替换文档，因此图例保留和单图修订不跨整体替换保留。

## 流式链路

`createChartStreamBuffer` 已迁到 runtime，保留 A2UI 兼容导出。它缓冲解码后的 JSON，不证明传输完成。`readOllamaStream` 严格增量解码 UTF-8 NDJSON，传输限 4 MiB、文档限 1 MiB，要求 `done:true` 且 `done_reason:"stop"`。截断、缺失终止帧、格式错误、取消或终止后仍有数据均不返回完成操作。

本地 Ollama 页面使用同源代理与 `stream:true`、120 秒期限、取消、生成 epoch 和起始图表修订；手动编辑使旧生成失效。最多两次有界修复，分别记录尝试。一次真实合成 qwen3.5:9b 首次通过，数值 [3,5] 保真，取消验证通过；见 [证据](../../specs/0034-chat-host-quality/ollama-verification.json)。这是冒烟测试，不是模型排名或事实检索服务。此解码器不支持 SSE；其他传输应自行解析帧后使用中立缓冲。

## 固定版本的本地宿主矩阵

| 宿主 | 输入与完成信号 | 聊天/主题/数据表 | 零尺寸 | 有序操作 | 图例保留 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OpenUI react-lang 1.0.2 / React 19.2.4 | JSON 字符串；上游 streaming=false | 支持 | 等待 | 宿主显式启用 | 兼容更新保留 |
| A2UI React 0.9.1 / web_core 0.9.2 | 解析后的 DynamicString；宿主完成操作 | 支持 | 等待 | 宿主显式启用 | 兼容更新保留 |
| COSUI Dynamic UI 1.0.0 / San 3.15.5 | document 对象；宿主完整输入 | 支持 | 等待 | 宿主显式启用 | 兼容更新保留 |
| Marklang 1.0.1 | 命名数据/指令；显式 complete=true | 支持 | 等待事务 | 显式拒绝 | 整体换文档时重置 |

选择、校验错误、有效恢复和销毁由共享 runtime 及固定真实 SDK 夹具验证。Marklang 仍要求可信或已净化 Markdown，本任务不净化任意 HTML。ChartNexus 操作信封不等于上游标准保证。远端宿主、水合、其他 SDK 版本、移动设备认证和全面无障碍认证仍未验证。见 [M2 spec](../../specs/0034-chat-host-quality/spec.zh-CN.md)。

## M3 图表扩充

0.3 在原有七类基础上新增雷达、树、桑基和可信区域地图。见[契约、宿主 MapRegistry、模型资源和预览](chart-expansion-03.md)。浏览器/SVG/worker 与四种固定上游 SDK 路径已有本地证据；M4 模型评测和分发仍是独立工作。固定渲染器标签回调保留原文，仍禁止模型回调。

# Chat presentation profile
[简体中文](../zh-CN/chat-presentation.md)

This host opt-in profile supports 0.2/0.3 intent charts. `compileChatChart(document,settings,registry?)` returns `{plan,adjustments}`; runtime uses `mountChart(container,onSelect,{chatPresentation:settings})`; SVG uses `renderSvg(document,{chatPresentation:settings})`. All four local GenUI profiles support chat settings. MCP validate/compile/render accept chatPresentation; render dimensions use the tool's width/height parameters.

Host theme/background/detail settings take precedence over document preferences. Defaults are light, transparent and standard. Five levels are minimal/simple/standard/detailed/comprehensive. Minimal hides optional titles/grid/labels; simple shows supplied titles; standard adds grid; detailed and comprehensive request more labels, with comprehensive endpoint ticks and axis tooltips. Necessary identity, legend, units and scales remain mandatory. Explicit labels may be suppressed for density when dimensions are provided, with notices and full-data alternatives. No values, nulls, ordering or units are changed for aesthetics.

Core callers may supply width/height/target in settings; runtime and SVG use actual/requested dimensions. Layout fallback, token contrast conditions, keyboard source/rendered tables, SVG metadata, lifecycle and the pinned host matrix are detailed in [chat host quality](chat-host-quality.md). `adjustments` retains the old REQUIRED_LEGEND/LABEL_DENSITY_LIMIT mapping; structured `plan.notices` additionally describes layout fallback and density constraints. Runtime callbacks expose diagnostics, while callers can inspect plans separately.

No automatic host-background detection, arbitrary themes, zoom capability, mobile certification or general accessibility certification is claimed. The true local Ollama result is a synthetic smoke check, not model ranking; broader held-out evaluation remains open.

# ChartNexus: entry for models and agents

[简体中文](../zh-CN/model-entry.md)

ChartNexus compiles constrained JSON chart documents to Apache ECharts. For new 0.3 intent generation, discover `chartnexus://capabilities/basic-0.3`, then `chartnexus://schema/chart-document/0.3` and `chartnexus://recipes/manifest/0.1`. Follow the host profile: chat accepts only 0.2/0.3 intent; non-chat also accepts 0.1 intent/native. The inventory `chartnexus://resources/index/0.1` and JSONL corpus `chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1` expose canonical sources and hashes; hashes identify source bytes, not necessarily serialized MCP responses.

Choose `mode: intent` for supported bar, line, pie, scatter, combo, funnel or heatmap charts in 0.2. Use 0.1 `mode: echarts` only in a non-chat host that enables native input. Never invent fields or capabilities, execute callbacks, fetch URLs, aggregate implicitly, or treat null as zero. Native validation is partial.

Use `validate_chart` for structural and semantic validation. On failure, inspect diagnostic code and path, retrieve a repair example, revise the document, and validate again. `compile_chart` yields an ECharts plan; `render_chart` returns a session-local static SVG resource. Interactivity belongs to a browser host. Data references require a host-supplied registry and revision; never invent accessible datasets.

Start with [bar example](../../resources/recipes/bar.json), [field-error example](../../resources/recipes/unknown-field.json), [diagnostics](../../resources/diagnostics.json), and [GenUI host guide](genui-integrations.md). The [20-task development corpus](../../resources/evaluation/tasks.json) is synthetic and public; it is not a hidden benchmark or real-model result. See [evaluation guide](evaluation-baseline.md) for scoring and limitations.

For ordered browser-host updates, the host captures `baseRevision` before asynchronous generation and supplies a unique `operationId`; do not invent revisions. A `REVISION_CONFLICT` requires obtaining the current revision and resolving the stale work before retrying. A changed payload needs a new operation ID. The optional A2UI, OpenUI and COSUI JSON host profiles use the same ChartNexus operation contract; they are not protocol-native guarantees. See the [GenUI host guide](genui-integrations.md).

An experimental intent-only 0.2 profile is discoverable via `chartnexus://capabilities/basic-0.2` and `chartnexus://schema/chart-document/0.2`. The `get_chart_schema` tool defaults to 0.1; pass `schemaVersion: "0.2"` to retrieve the 0.2 intent schema. Native 0.1 validation is guarded and partial, and the validation result reports `guarded-native-partial`.

For experimental 0.2 bar, line or pie sorting, explicitly set `chart.sort` with `by` (`category` or `value`), `order` (`ascending` or `descending`) and `nulls` (`first` or `last`). Never sort grouped charts by value: the current profile rejects this ambiguous request; aggregation must be resolved upstream. Category order uses UTF-16 code-unit comparison, not locale.

For 0.2 dates use line x `type: temporal`, `temporalKind: date` and valid `YYYY-MM-DD` strings; offset-bearing instants are supported separately, without timezone inference. Declare y units explicitly; percent scale `percent` and `ratio` describe original values and never trigger conversion. Read the 0.2 schema and capabilities before generating.

For 0.2 bar, line and pie, aggregate repeated categories only when the user explicitly requests it: set `chart.aggregate.op` to `sum`, `mean`, or `count`. Count is non-null numeric y count, not total row count; sum/mean ignore null. Do not invent grouping, units, or treat an aggregate as one source row.

For native ECharts input, default validation is partial. When the host requests the small strict subset, read `chartnexus://schema/native-strict-basic/0.1` and call `validate_chart` with `nativeValidation: "strict-basic-0.1"`. Do not claim strict validation of arbitrary ECharts options or silently retry a failure in the partial profile.

For experimental 0.2 intent charts, use `presentation.dataLabels.show` and `presentation.legend.show` with optional legend `position` (`top` or `bottom`). Label content is the ECharts default for that chart type; do not invent formatters or imply automatic percentage conversion.

For 0.2 line time instants use `temporalKind: "instant"` and full ISO strings with `Z` or an explicit numeric offset. Do not omit offsets or invent one. Category sorting compares actual instants; different strings for the same instant are rejected. Display is UTC.

For 0.2 intent, retrieve `chartnexus://recipes/combo/0.2` and `chartnexus://recipes/funnel/0.2` for supported combination and funnel examples. A combo uses a bar and line with distinct fields; shared axes require matching units or both unspecified, while an explicitly requested right axis requires units on both. Never infer conversion rates for funnels or silently convert values.

For 0.2 categorical heatmaps, read `chartnexus://recipes/heatmap/0.2`. Supply distinct x, y and numeric color fields plus explicit min/max from the data or user; do not invent a range, fill missing cells with zero, or implicitly aggregate duplicates.

The host may enable the 0.2 chat profile through `chatPresentation`; a user-requested detail level can be expressed as `presentation.detailLevel` (`minimal`, `simple`, `standard`, `detailed`, `comprehensive`). Host theme, background and level settings take precedence. Without host opt-in the document level does not change rendering. Never remove required legend or alter data for visual simplicity. See [chat profile](chat-presentation.md).

For 0.2 chat charts, read `chartnexus://recipes/chat-bar/0.2` for a valid row-based example and `chartnexus://recipes/funnel/0.2` for a different chart type. Use the user's actual rows and values; examples are not task answers. Theme version is the string `"1"`; omit optional transforms unless requested.

## Input contract and semantic notices

Hosts can call `getChartInputContract({ chatPresentation: true, orderedUpdates: false })` from runtime or any JSON adapter. It returns the recommended document schema, accepted profiles, canonical complete example and model description. With ordered updates the example is an illustrative envelope; the host must replace operationId/baseRevision with real session values. A2UI/OpenUI descriptions use this helper; COSUI hosts explicitly add it to their model prompt. Marklang also supports chat settings; ordered envelopes are explicitly rejected.

All-zero nonempty pie/donut values produce no sectors and return `dataState: "no-share"` plus informational `NO_SHARE_DATA`; empty pie returns `dataState: "empty"` without that notice. Preserve the values. Grouped series expose raw group values and display names through `seriesMetadata`; empty labels are disambiguated. These are series identities, not stable row IDs.

## M1/M2 implementation

See [0.3 contracts and migration](contracts-03.md) and [chat host quality/support matrix](chat-host-quality.md) for current version discovery, dimensions, tables, lifecycle, legend retention and real local Ollama streaming evidence. Legacy spec evidence remains historical.

## M3 chart expansion

0.3 now supports radar, tree, Sankey and trusted regional maps in addition to the original seven types. See [contracts, host MapRegistry, resources and preview](chart-expansion-03.md). Browser/SVG/worker and four pinned upstream SDK paths have local evidence; M4 model evaluation and distribution remain separate. Fixed renderer-owned label callbacks preserve text literally; model callbacks remain forbidden.

# ChartNexus：模型与 Agent 入口

[English](../en/model-entry.md)

ChartNexus 将受约束的 JSON 图表文档编译为 Apache ECharts。新生成的 0.3 意图图表优先发现 `chartnexus://capabilities/basic-0.3`、`chartnexus://schema/chart-document/0.3` 和 `chartnexus://recipes/manifest/0.1`。遵循宿主 profile：聊天仅接受 0.2/0.3 intent；非聊天也接受 0.1 intent/native。资源清单 `chartnexus://resources/index/0.1` 与 JSONL 语料 `chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1` 提供规范源与哈希；哈希对应源文件字节，不一定对应 MCP 序列化响应。

0.2 的 `mode: intent` 支持柱状、折线、饼图、散点、组合、漏斗和热力图。仅在接受 native 的非聊天宿主中使用 0.1 `mode: echarts`。不得虚构字段或能力、执行回调、拉取 URL、隐式聚合或将 null 当作零。原生配置验证仍是部分验证。

使用 `validate_chart` 做结构和语义校验；失败后查看诊断码及路径、读取修复示例、修改文档并重新校验。`compile_chart` 返回 ECharts 计划；`render_chart` 返回会话内静态 SVG 资源。交互由浏览器宿主提供。数据引用依赖宿主提供的可信 registry 和 revision，不要编造可访问的数据集。

从[柱状图示例](../../resources/recipes/bar.json)、[字段错误示例](../../resources/recipes/unknown-field.json)、[诊断说明](../../resources/diagnostics.json)和 [GenUI 宿主指南](genui-integrations.md)开始。[20 任务开发集](../../resources/evaluation/tasks.json)为公开合成样例，不是隐藏基准，也不代表真实模型成绩；评分与限制见[评测指南](evaluation-baseline.md)。

对于浏览器宿主的顺序更新，宿主须在异步生成前捕获 `baseRevision` 并提供唯一 `operationId`；不要编造版本。遇到 `REVISION_CONFLICT` 时须获取当前版本并处理过期任务后再重试。内容改变时需要新的操作 ID。可选的 A2UI、OpenUI 和 COSUI JSON 宿主 profile 使用相同的 ChartNexus 操作契约；这不是协议原生保证。详见 [GenUI 宿主指南](genui-integrations.md)。

实验性、仅 intent 的 0.2 profile 可通过 `chartnexus://capabilities/basic-0.2` 和 `chartnexus://schema/chart-document/0.2` 发现。`get_chart_schema` 工具默认返回 0.1；传入 `schemaVersion: "0.2"` 可获取 0.2 intent Schema。原生 0.1 仅进行受控的部分校验，校验结果标记为 `guarded-native-partial`。

实验性 0.2 柱状、折线或饼图排序须显式设置 `chart.sort`，包含 `by`（`category` 或 `value`）、`order`（`ascending` 或 `descending`）和 `nulls`（`first` 或 `last`）。不要对分组图按数值排序：当前 profile 会拒绝此歧义请求，需在上游明确处理聚合。分类使用 UTF-16 代码单元顺序，而非语言环境排序。

0.2 日期使用折线图 x 的 `type: temporal`、`temporalKind: date` 和有效 `YYYY-MM-DD` 字符串；带偏移时间点单独支持，不推断时区。y 单位须显式声明；百分比 `percent` 与 `ratio` 描述原值，不触发换算。生成前读取 0.2 Schema 和能力清单。

0.2 柱状、折线或饼图只有在用户明确要求时才可通过 `chart.aggregate.op` 设置 `sum`、`mean` 或 `count` 聚合重复分类。count 是非 null 数值 y 的数量，不是总行数；sum/mean 忽略 null。不要编造分组、单位，也不要把聚合结果当作单个原始行。

原生 ECharts 输入默认只做部分校验。当宿主要求有限的严格子集时，先读取 `chartnexus://schema/native-strict-basic/0.1`，再调用 `validate_chart` 并传入 `nativeValidation: "strict-basic-0.1"`。不要声称任意 ECharts option 均通过严格校验，也不要在失败后静默改用部分校验。

实验性 0.2 intent 可通过 `presentation.dataLabels.show` 和 `presentation.legend.show` 控制标签及图例，图例可选 `position`（`top` 或 `bottom`）。标签内容采用该图表类型的 ECharts 默认值，不要编造 formatter 或暗示百分比自动换算。

0.2 折线图时间点使用 `temporalKind: "instant"`，输入完整的带 `Z` 或数字偏移的 ISO 字符串。不要省略或编造偏移。分类排序按实际时间比较，同一时间点的不同字符串会被拒绝；显示为 UTC。

0.2 intent 可读取 `chartnexus://recipes/combo/0.2` 与 `chartnexus://recipes/funnel/0.2` 了解受支持的组合图和漏斗图。组合图使用两个不同字段，默认共享轴要求单位相同或均不声明；显式右轴要求双方均声明单位。不要为漏斗图推断转化率，也不要静默换算数值。

生成 0.2 分类热力图前读取 `chartnexus://recipes/heatmap/0.2`。提供不同的 x、y 和数值颜色字段，以及数据或用户明确给出的 min/max；不要编造范围、把缺失格填成零或隐式聚合重复值。

宿主可通过 `chatPresentation` 启用 0.2 聊天展示 profile；用户要求的详略可写入 `presentation.detailLevel`（`minimal`、`simple`、`standard`、`detailed`、`comprehensive`）。宿主的主题、背景和档位设置优先；未启用 profile 时文档档位不改变渲染。不要为了简洁删减必要图例或数据。详见[聊天展示](chat-presentation.md)。

0.2 聊天图表可先读取 `chartnexus://recipes/chat-bar/0.2` 了解正确的逐行数据结构，再读取 `chartnexus://recipes/funnel/0.2` 了解另一种图表。使用用户实际数据和数值，示例不是任务答案。主题版本是字符串 `"1"`；用户未要求时不要添加可选变换。

## 输入契约与语义提示

宿主可从 runtime 或各 JSON adapter 调用 `getChartInputContract({ chatPresentation: true, orderedUpdates: false })`，获取推荐文档 schema、接受的 profile、完整规范示例和模型描述。有序更新示例是示意信封，宿主必须用实际会话值替换 operationId/baseRevision。A2UI/OpenUI 描述使用此 helper；COSUI 宿主显式将其加入模型提示词。Marklang 已支持聊天设置；显式拒绝有序操作信封。

非空且全零的饼图/环图不绘制扇区，返回 `dataState: "no-share"` 与信息级 `NO_SHARE_DATA`；空饼图返回 `dataState: "empty"`，不附该提示。保留原始数值。分组序列通过 `seriesMetadata` 暴露原始分组值和显示名称，空名称进行消歧。这是序列身份，不是稳定行 ID。

## M1/M2 实施

当前版本发现、迁移、尺寸、数据表、生命周期、图例保留及真实本地 Ollama 流式证据见 [0.3 契约](contracts-03.md) 与 [聊天宿主质量/支持矩阵](chat-host-quality.md)。旧 spec 的验证记录保留为历史证据。

## M3 图表扩充

0.3 在原有七类基础上新增雷达、树、桑基和可信区域地图。见[契约、宿主 MapRegistry、模型资源和预览](chart-expansion-03.md)。浏览器/SVG/worker 与四种固定上游 SDK 路径已有本地证据；M4 模型评测和分发仍是独立工作。固定渲染器标签回调保留原文，仍禁止模型回调。

# Offline evaluation baseline

[简体中文](../zh-CN/evaluation-baseline.md)

The [20 tasks](../../resources/evaluation/tasks.json) are project-authored synthetic development fixtures, licensed Apache-2.0. Each records a bilingual prompt, stable task and family IDs, split, provenance, reference document and observable checks. Editing and repair tasks include a prior document. Diagnostic tasks provide `inputDocument`; the candidate must be an object with `diagnosticCode` and `diagnosticPath`. The checker verifies the claim against the compiler and relevant input constraints. This is a public development set; do not use it as a held-out test or claim it measures real models. All tasks are in the development split; no training or held-out test set has been created.

Run `pnpm eval:self` to check reference fixtures. For external candidates, create a JSON object mapping each task ID to its ChartDocument or diagnostic object, then run `pnpm eval:candidates /path/to/candidates.json`. For example, a diagnostic answer can be `{"diagnosticCode":"UNKNOWN_FIELD","diagnosticPath":"/chart/encoding"}`. The report includes per-task compilation, diagnostics and invariant checks; missing candidates fail, unknown IDs are rejected, and the process returns 0 only if all tasks pass. Input is local and capped at 25 MiB total; the compiler enforces its individual document limits.

Assertions test chart type, values, ordering and other task-specific properties of the compiled plan, not byte-identical options. Some representations may still be rejected because the current assertions are intentionally narrow. A pass does not prove visual quality, safety of an entire host, protocol compatibility, model accuracy, or completion of a multi-turn interaction: the baseline evaluates the final candidate against the supplied previous document as task context; it does not replay conversations. Human review and actual model runs remain separate work.

For retrieval, the generated [JSONL corpus](../../resources/model-retrieval.jsonl) contains source bodies, stable IDs, language, license and SHA-256. MCP exposes the same data as `chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1`. It includes public reference answers; exclude it from model context when measuring independent task success.

# 离线评测基线

[English](../en/evaluation-baseline.md)

[20 个任务](../../resources/evaluation/tasks.json)为项目自行编写的合成开发样例，许可证 Apache-2.0。每项包含双语提示词、稳定任务与家族 ID、数据划分、来源、参考文档和可执行断言；编辑与修复任务附带上一轮文档。诊断类任务通过 `inputDocument` 提供待诊断输入；候选结果必须是包含 `diagnosticCode` 和 `diagnosticPath` 的对象，评分器会将该声明与编译器和相关输入条件对照。这是公开开发集，不能作为隐藏测试集，也不能宣称测得真实模型表现。所有任务目前均属于 development；尚未建立训练集或独立测试集。

运行 `pnpm eval:self` 检查参考样例。评测外部候选时，创建以任务 ID 为键、对应 ChartDocument 或诊断对象为值的 JSON 对象，运行 `pnpm eval:candidates /path/to/candidates.json`。例如诊断答案可写为 `{"diagnosticCode":"UNKNOWN_FIELD","diagnosticPath":"/chart/encoding"}`。报告逐项给出编译、诊断和断言结果；缺失候选失败，未知 ID 被拒绝，全部通过时退出码才为 0。输入仅在本地处理，总大小不超过 25 MiB；每个文档另受编译器限制。

断言检查编译结果的图表类型、数值、顺序等任务性质，不要求 option 文本逐字一致；但目前规则较窄，一些等价表示仍可能被拒绝。通过不代表视觉质量、宿主整体安全、协议兼容、模型准确率或已完成多轮交互：此基线把上一轮文档作为任务上下文，仅评估最终候选，不重放对话。人工评审和真实模型运行需要单独进行。

检索用途的[生成式 JSONL 资源](../../resources/model-retrieval.jsonl)包含源正文、稳定 ID、语言、许可证和 SHA-256；MCP 通过 `chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1` 提供相同数据。该资源包含公开参考答案；测量独立任务成功率时应将其排除在模型上下文之外。
